title: ContentReport
description: incidents/{id}/contentReports/{reportId}: a member flags shared content as a problem (App Review guideline 1.2). A searcher or family member creates its own, once; command reads every report, the author only its own; nobody updates or deletes one. reportId is the document id (32 lowercase hex).

target.description: What is flagged: the team's shared task (the current plan's assignment), the family's description of the person (profile/shared), or one event (a report, a sighting).

targetId.description: For event: the event id (32 lowercase hex). For task: the plan document id. For family_description: null.

reason.description: Why: abusive or offensive; personal information that should not be shared; wrong or misleading; other.

note.description: Optional words from the reporter, phone numbers removed before it is stored.

createdAt.description: Firestore server timestamp of the write (request.time).
